# Lonside Studio — Custom Web & Digital Product Engineering

> Lonside is a high-velocity digital engineering studio specializing in fixed-price 14 and 30-day sprints for founders, startups, and SMBs. 100% source code ownership on private client GitHub, zero technical debt, guaranteed on-time delivery.

## Studio Positioning & Model
Lonside replaces traditional slow web agencies and risky freelance setups by delivering production-grade web applications with fixed scopes, fixed budgets, and guaranteed deadlines.

- Website: https://www.lonside.com

- GitHub Organization: https://github.com/lonsidestudio
- Primary Stack: Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase / PostgreSQL (RLS), Stripe Billing, Resend, PostHog.
- Direct Contact: hello@lonside.com

## Flagship Offers & Pricing

### 1. Sprint Launch (14 Business Days)
- Price: 6 900 € excl. VAT (Fixed price package • Zero budget creep)
- Target: MVPs, first production release, SaaS launch, client portals.
- Key Deliverables:
  - Full-stack responsive web application (mobile-first).
  - Secure authentication & user session management.
  - Stripe payments & subscription customer portal.
  - Essential third-party API and database integrations.
  - 100% source code transferred to client's private GitHub repository.
  - 30-day post-launch corrective warranty and support.

### 2. Sprint Scale (30 Business Days)
- Price: 13 900 € excl. VAT (Fixed price package • 2 milestones)
- Target: Multi-role platforms, complex operational workflows, dispatch & data platforms.
- Key Deliverables:
  - Everything included in Sprint Launch.
  - Multi-tenant and multi-role portals (e.g., Buyer, Seller, Manager, Admin).
  - Automated business data processing and computation engines.
  - Real-time notifications and background job orchestration.
  - Rigorous automated test suite (Vitest / unit & integration).
  - Architecture documentation & Loom video code walkthrough.
  - 45-day post-launch warranty.

### 3. Embedded Squad / Régie d'Immersion (Post-Launch Continuity)
- Price: From 5 500 € / month (Flexible monthly allocation)
- Target: Funded startups and scaling platforms requiring continuous engineering.
- Integration: Senior engineer embedded directly in client Slack and GitHub routines with zero onboarding delay.

---

## Core Guarantees & Standards
1. Guaranteed Delivery or Penalty: 10% discount refunded per 48 hours of studio delay.
2. 100% Intellectual Property: All commits, schemas, and design components pushed directly to client GitHub. Zero proprietary lock-in.
3. No Scope Creep: Fixed and mutually approved roadmap before line one of code is written.
4. Day-1 Growth Stack: Pre-configured analytics, transactional emails, and Stripe billing.

## Featured Case Studies
- Eunice KM (HealthTech, Clinical Nutrition & D2C Organic E-Commerce): Bespoke Shopify storefront uniting an organic afro-botanical apothecary (27 EU markets, smart €69 AJAX cart drawer) and an online certified clinical nutrition practice (CAM Method) shipped in 14 days.
- Welqo (PropTech & Luxury Vacation Rental): Real-time multi-channel booking calendar, dynamic event pricing engine, eIDAS paperless mandate signing.
- Weedin (EventTech & B2B Ticketing): High-conversion ticketing platform with dynamic seat allocation, fraud-proof QR code generation, and multi-tier access control.
- Bely (Mobilité & Dispatch Temps Réel): High-velocity dispatch engine with sub-second driver matching and automated fleet telemetry.
- Michi 道 (Supply Chain & Predictive Inventory Forecasting): Enterprise inventory forecasting pipeline computing multi-channel run-rates in under 1 second.
